summary: This note describes Mount Franklin, a mountain in the Brindabella Ranges. It lies on the border between the Australian Capital Territory and New South Wales, Australia, with its summit located in the Australian Capital Territory. The note gives no elevation figure, as the value is missing from the text.
one_line: Mount Franklin is a mountain in the Brindabella Ranges on the Australian Capital Territory and New South Wales border.
